title: MenuItem
description: An individual menu item that a diner can order for delivery or pickup.

external_id.description: A unique external identifier for diff-based ingestion.

name.description: The display name of the menu item.

description.description: A description of the menu item.

price.description: The base price of the menu item in the merchant's currency.

available.description: Whether this item is currently available for ordering.

modifier_prompts.description: Modifier prompts for this item, such as salad dressing choice or add-on toppings.
